ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the query carried an explicitly warm, appreciative tone ("you're a star," "I always enjoy working with you"), which maps directly to Plover's highest self-reported preference family (warm, collaborative exchanges, win-rate 70). Capability on the relevant dimension (Creative Generation: Plover 83.4 vs Willet 84.7) is within the stated ±2.0 variance band, so it's effectively a tie — meaning quality wasn't a deciding factor. With capability roughly equal, I routed to the model whose self-reported task preference best matched the query's character. Note this preference is about which tasks the model reports enjoying, not measured output quality; I used it as a tiebreaker, not a quality claim.
